findings.text: the case name still claims the retired commits-its-registration contract while the body asserts zero commits and no roster row, so a reader scanning ids reads the retired contract as covered.
the name still claims unnamed dispatches reuse their captured session while the body asserts a third disposable identity and no reuse, a name that now contradicts the assertions it fronts.
the landing record quotes 13 passed in 6.23 s but its named receipt logs/head-arm-three-files.log carries 13 passed in 10.87s, so the duration is not verifiable from the receipt it points at.

item_verdicts.diff: read against ecd1528c; the single commit rewrites the two cases, adds the named-member companion, and records the landing in the plan and evidence files, touching no production source.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names the two case ids, the three gate files passing whole at the head and zero added failure ids against 7e90064d; the manifest records all three and my own run at the landed head reproduces the gate (13 passed, exit 0).
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to rewrite the two member tests that still asserted the retired shared session member; the bodies at tests/test_member_registration_commits.py:254 and tests/test_crew_ephemeral_members.py:94 now assert the disposable-<run id> identity, though both case names still state the retired contract.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the gate result, the base and head arms with their failure ids, and the read-only-.git blocker, and the committed test blobs hash to the sha256 digests it records so the tested content is the committed content.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the node declared five paths and commit 8cedd826 touches four of them, the two test files, the evidence anchor and the plan's section, with nothing else in the diff.

justifications.durability: reverting reckon/crew/dispatch.py:3681 to a session-derived member leaves the rewritten assertions false, since the member id loses its disposable- prefix, rev-list --count becomes 1 and the roster gains a row, and the base arm shows that contract red at 7e90064d.
justifications.evidence: head-arm-three-files.log carries the 13-passed gate on the digests the commit holds and base-arm-named-tests.log carries the 2-failure reproduction, but docs/evidence/archive/new-work-gets-a-new-worker-landed.html:710 quotes 6.23 s where its named receipt says 10.87 s.
justifications.fit: the rewritten cases reuse tests/test_crew_ephemeral_members.py's own helpers and style and introduce no plan, ticket or version identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/test_member_registration_commits.py:278 asserts the disposable member and tests/test_member_registration_commits.py:280 asserts zero commits, so the retired contract survives only in the case names at tests/test_member_registration_commits.py:254 and tests/test_crew_ephemeral_members.py:94.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in commit 8cedd826 is inside the declared write paths and no reckon/ source file is touched.
